source: hand-written; each machine instance describes the loaded plug-in itself (IBuzzMachineManifest)
summary: Hosts a CLAP or VST3 effect plug-in. Pick the plug-in from the Gear menu (or machine_add with plugin=...); its first 64 automatable parameters appear as slots, named and shown in the plug-in's own units.
use_for: Run a CLAP or VST3 effect on a signal, with a sidechain on input 2.
